stops.note: literally "one from over the horizon", used for foreigners and later especially for white or Western visitors
stops.meaning: a foreigner, especially a white or Western person

stops.note: entered English print describing Ghanaian usage of the term for outsiders
stops.meaning: a foreigner in Ghana, especially a white person

current_meaning: a Ghanaian (Akan) term, used in English, for a foreigner or outsider, especially one of European descent
